notes: Partition verified: all 55 source tokens and all 71 target tokens are covered exactly once across the 52 units (one `added` and four fusions of a host with its directive he).

The italic *whatsoever* is a supplied lexical subject and is the verse's only `added` unit; the italic *is* and *shall be* are construction-supplied copulas and go to the two prepositional predicates לְ and מִן, headed on the prepositions (rules 20, 49).
אֶל־פְּנֵי is split (*in* / *front*) because each morpheme has an English word of its own, with the *of* going to the rectum under rule 19.
The directive-he forms (יָמָּה, קֵדְמָה, קָדִימָה) each share a unit with their host under rules 30 and 32, since one English word carries host and direction together.
לְעֻמּוֹת is divided as *unto* (preposition) / *answerable* (noun), consistent with the לְעֻמַּת division in 45:6.
